text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
A sun-drenched beach! A heated battle with 
the title of the Strongest Generation on 
the line... There is no better stage for a 
preliminary clash!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! For the heroes of the Golden 
Generation, whom I am destined to defeat, 
are also taking part in this training 
camp!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Forward march, T.M. Opera O Opera Troupe! 
We shall engage them in a water fight 
while bolstering our own fighting 
strength!
